_note: Hotel areas by tier with a base nightly range per room for the shoulder season (April / October), before fees. Multiply by the month's season multiplier, then apply hotel_fees. No free API gives Dubai hotel prices, so all rates and multipliers are author estimates from typical 2025-26 online-travel-agency ranges (research.md §2.6).
